message: Vector Rebel 3.2.48 fixes another clipped PPE Name edge case reported by Baldree (hood).
releaseNotes: Baldree's Hood PPE list included an added literal ellipsis (BALDREE-3290326-BU...) even though its complete equipment name was BALDREE-3290326-BU. Now accepts exact matching title with no additional characters only when the precise pool/item page and labeled serial match. No safety bypass or changes to actual inspection submissions.
